dedupe_keys.name: stray parameter evaluation of voltage transformers for pq measurement in mv applications

description: Crotti Gabriella and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. A simplified numerical-experimental model represents inductive medium-voltage transformers and their wideband power-quality behaviour. It investigates environmental and circuit influence factors using estimated stray parameters and experimentally validates its predictions. Coverage is the source-described transformer study; the native abstract does not provide all equivalent-circuit elements, operating points or fitted coefficients. The record describes an existing physical model, while the related experiment collections supply calibration evidence for particular instruments. Zenodo supplies the descriptive publication with open access under cc-by-4.0. The publication does not establish public access to an implementation or its separate licence. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations.
